title: The first Christmas card was a scandal

scenes.say: Your Christmas cards started with a SCANDAL. A naughty picture, a very busy man, and a price that'll make you spit out your tea!
London, eighteen forty three. This is Henry Cole. He's drowning in letters he can't be bothered to answer. So, lazy genius, he gets an artist friend to draw ONE card for everybody!
So posting it was cheap, because Henry helped bring in the Penny Post. One penny, to send a letter anywhere in Britain. Lovely!
But look at the picture! A family raising glasses of wine, and a little girl having a sip! The anti drink lot were FURIOUS. It was meant to be cosy! Scandalous!
He printed a thousand and sold them for a shilling each. That's five pence now, but back then it was a LOT for a card. So it flopped! Oops. Mind you, his museum now keeps over thirty thousand cards.
So what about posting a card now? A first class stamp is one pound eighty! It used to be a penny, darling. I nearly fainted.
And that flop? One of Henry's cards sold for twenty THOUSAND pounds in two thousand and one! Would you pay that? Because every card you send copies him. So yes,
